title: Streamable HTTP MCP server answers 406 Not Acceptable to a hand-written client
symptoms: Not Acceptable: Client must accept both application/json and text/event-stream
curl or fetch POSTs to the MCP endpoint fail while real MCP clients work
A JSON-only Accept header is rejected even with enableJsonResponse true
cause: The Streamable HTTP transport requires every POST to send an Accept header listing both application/json and text/event-stream, because the server may answer either way. The TypeScript SDK server rejects a request that lists only one.
fix: Send both media types in Accept on every POST and handle both a JSON body and an SSE stream in the response.
apply: curl -X POST https://example.com/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'
affected: MCP Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-03-26 and later; @modelcontextprotocol/sdk StreamableHTTPServerTransport, as of 2026-10
